label: Uniform
description: Professional uniforms with the worn-in details that sell the job.

items.name: pilot-flight-suit
items.text: an olive nomex flight suit, squadron patches on the shoulders, zips half-open, aviators hooked at the collar

items.name: naval-dress
items.text: crisp naval dress whites, gold rank insignia, ribbon bars squared above the breast pocket

items.name: racing-overalls
items.text: sponsor-patched fireproof racing overalls, sleeves tied at the waist over a sweat-damp base layer

items.name: chef-whites
items.text: double-breasted chef whites, side towel tucked into the apron string, knife roll under one arm

items.name: surgeon-scrubs
items.text: teal surgical scrubs, cap tied back, mask hanging loose at the throat

items.name: firefighter-turnout
items.text: soot-marked firefighter turnout gear, reflective triple-trim bands, helmet carried under one arm

items.name: airline-crew
items.text: a tailored airline crew uniform, fitted jacket and pencil skirt, knotted silk neck scarf

items.name: park-ranger
items.text: a park ranger uniform, khaki shirt with a brass badge, wide-brim campaign hat

items.name: astronaut-suit
items.text: an orange astronaut launch-entry suit, pressure connectors at chest and thigh, mission patches, helmet carried at the hip

items.name: fencing-whites
items.text: crisp fencing whites, quilted plastron under a high-collared jacket, mesh mask cradled in one arm, épée resting against the shoulder

items.name: equestrian-show
items.text: show-jumping attire, fitted navy riding coat over white breeches, tall polished field boots, leather gloves and a velvet-covered helmet
